source_verification.oracle: {R}, Return Grinning Ignus to its owner's hand: Add {C}{C}{R}. Activate only as a sorcery.
Whenever you cast a spell, add {R}. Until end of turn, you don't lose this mana as steps and phases end.
During your turn, spells you cast from your hand with mana value X or less have cascade, where X is the total amount of life your opponents have lost this turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, each player draws a card and loses 1 life.
